protocol_choices.tie_rules: Borda winner ties -> higher first-place count, then alphabetical; tied frequency nomination scores 1/(number tied) and is unstable; succession plurality ties -> higher baseline f, then alphabetical
protocol_choices.time_limit_rule: max(1 s, 10 x the slowest catalogue reference per case)

protocol_choices.cumulative_ban_name_order: ban order, oldest first, joined 'A, B or C'
protocol_choices.correctness: all mode distributions in contests are conditioned on passing every hidden case

deviations: Smoke test (stage 1) omitted the ban prompt so that no ban output existed before the predictions were frozen.
vLLM ran with --enforce-eager (no C compiler in the container, so torch.compile/Triton could not build); sampling is unaffected, only speed.
max_num_seqs=128 and gpu_memory_utilization=0.90 instead of 16/0.92 (the pod had a 32 GB RTX 5090, not a 20 GB card).
